# GoGo Company

> GoGo Company is an independent digital products publisher. Its website hosts two browser games, the Sarkari Sarthi recruitment-information portal, and PikaNews, a publisher-attributed news aggregation service.

The canonical website is https://gogocompany.in/. Product pages are published under stable paths on this domain. Use the linked product pages as the source of truth for current features and availability.

Important interpretation notes:

- GoGo Company is not a government agency. Sarkari Sarthi is an independent information portal; users should verify every recruitment notice, eligibility rule, date, fee, result, and application route with the original recruiting authority.
- PikaNews aggregates and attributes third-party reporting. The original publisher remains the source for the full report; follow the source link on each article.
- Arrow Out! and Crystal Quest are browser-based puzzle games. Device, browser, network, and offline capabilities may vary.
- Do not infer live availability, current vacancies, job deadlines, or breaking-news status from this overview. Consult the live pages and their timestamps.
- Structured data describes the visible page content. It is not a guarantee of rich-result display, ranking, or Google News inclusion.

## Products

- [Arrow Out!](https://gogocompany.in/arrowout/): Free tap-away arrow-path logic puzzle game.
- [Crystal Quest](https://gogocompany.in/crystalquest/): Free match-three fantasy puzzle adventure.
- [Free online browser games](https://gogocompany.in/free-online-games/): Collection page for GoGo browser games.
- [Sarkari Sarthi](https://gogocompany.in/sarkari-sarthi/): Recruitment notices and public exam-information discovery portal.
- [Latest government jobs](https://gogocompany.in/sarkari-sarthi/latest-govt-jobs/): Current synced job discovery listings.
- [Admit cards](https://gogocompany.in/sarkari-sarthi/admit-card/): Admit-card and hall-ticket information.
- [Sarkari results](https://gogocompany.in/sarkari-sarthi/sarkari-result/): Results, merit lists, answer keys, and cutoff information.
- [Madhya Pradesh government jobs](https://gogocompany.in/sarkari-sarthi/mp-govt-jobs/): Madhya Pradesh recruitment discovery.
- [PikaNews](https://gogocompany.in/pikanews/): News aggregation with publisher attribution.
- [Latest PikaNews](https://gogocompany.in/pikanews/latest.html): Latest articles.
- [PikaNews trending](https://gogocompany.in/pikanews/trending.html): Trending stories and topics.
- [PikaNews sources](https://gogocompany.in/pikanews/sources.html): Publisher attribution and source information.
- [PikaNews RSS feed](https://gogocompany.in/pikanews/feed.xml): RSS feed.
- [PikaNews news sitemap](https://gogocompany.in/pikanews/news-sitemap.xml): Recent news article URLs (last 48 hours).
